info.title: Everbility Public API
info.description: Pull reports from Everbility, upload notes and files, poll asynchronous jobs, and generate reports from saved templates. Partner endpoints let approved platforms connect practices with OAuth 2.0, launch report-writing sessions, and retrieve completed documents.

get.description: Verify the API key, confirm whether it is a user or organisation key, and inspect the effective scope.
Search clients that are visible to the current API key scope.

schema.title: Response List Client Documents V1 External Clients  Client Id  Documents Get

get.description: List reports for a client that is visible to the current API key scope.
Fetch a single report and render it as Markdown or HTML on demand.

post.description: Create a client note from Markdown content and return the created note ID.
Upload a PDF for asynchronous processing into a client note. Poll the returned job ID until completion.
Upload a large audio file for asynchronous transcription into a client note. Poll the returned job ID until completion.

get.description: Check the status of a public async job, including PDF-processing, large-audio transcription, and report-generation jobs.

schema.title: Response List Templates V1 External Templates Get

get.description: List report-generation templates visible to the current API key scope.
Fetch a single report-generation template that is visible to the current API key scope.

post.description: Start backend report creation from a template ID and note IDs. If the template contains prompt nodes, the backend generates those sections from the supplied notes. If the template contains no prompt nodes, the backend saves the template content directly as a report. The response returns a job_id immediately; poll GET /v1/public/jobs/{job_id} until the job completes.

Exchange an authorization code (with its PKCE code_verifier) or a refresh token for a new access and refresh token pair. Accepts form-encoded or JSON bodies. Refresh tokens are single use: each refresh returns a new pair and revokes the previous access token. Reusing a consumed refresh token revokes the whole connection and requires re-authorization by a practice admin.

200.description: New token pair. The access token lasts 1 hour, the refresh token 90 days.

400.description: Invalid code, verifier, redirect_uri, or grant_type.

401.description: Invalid client credentials, or invalid, reused, or expired refresh token.

post.description: Revoke an entire partner connection by presenting any of its tokens (access or refresh) with your client credentials. All tokens for the connection are revoked and unfinished launch sessions expire. Always returns revoked: true, including for unknown or already-revoked tokens. Accepts form-encoded or JSON bodies.

Create a report-writing launch session for a clinician in the connected practice. Requires an Idempotency-Key header: retrying with the same key and identical body returns the original session; reusing a key with a different body fails with 409. Sessions expire 48 hours after creation if not completed. Open the returned launch_url for the clinician.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key per logical session (for example a UUID). Enables safe retries.

200.description: Session created (or the existing session for a repeated Idempotency-Key).

400.description: Missing Idempotency-Key, or clinician_email did not match exactly one verified practice member.

401.description: Invalid or expired access token, or the connection was revoked.

403.description: The mapped Everbility client is not accessible to the assigned clinician.

409.description: Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

get.description: Poll a launch session. Status moves created -> opened -> completed; sessions that pass their 48-hour expiry become expired. document_url is populated once the session is completed.

401.description: Invalid or expired access token, or the connection was revoked.

404.description: Unknown session_id, or the session belongs to a different connection.

get.description: Retrieve the rendered report attached to a completed launch session, as Markdown (default) or HTML. The document remains available on the completed session after the 48-hour session window.

401.description: Invalid or expired access token, or the connection was revoked.

404.description: Unknown session, or the attached document is no longer accessible.

409.description: The session has not been completed yet.

PartnerTokenRequest.title: PartnerTokenRequest
PartnerTokenRequest.description: Token request. Send as application/x-www-form-urlencoded or application/json. Fields beyond grant_type, client_id, and client_secret depend on the grant type.

client_id.title: Client Id
client_id.description: Your partner app's OAuth client ID.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Your partner app's OAuth client secret. Server-side only.

code.title: Code
code.description: Authorization code from the consent callback. Required for grant_type=authorization_code. Single use, expires after 5 minutes.

redirect_uri.title: Redirect Uri
redirect_uri.description: Must exactly match the registered redirect URI. Required for grant_type=authorization_code.

code_verifier.title: Code Verifier
code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier whose S256 challenge was sent to the consent page. Required for grant_type=authorization_code.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Current refresh token. Required for grant_type=refresh_token. Single use — a new pair is returned.

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: Opaque bearer token for partner endpoints. Valid for 1 hour.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Single-use refresh token. Valid for 90 days.

token.title: Token
token.description: Any access or refresh token from the connection to revoke.

external_client_id.title: External Client Id
external_client_id.description: Your platform's ID for the client. Used to remember the client mapping across sessions on this connection.

clinician_email.title: Clinician Email
clinician_email.description: Must match the verified email of exactly one member of the connected practice. Matching is case-insensitive.

client_first_name.title: Client First Name
client_first_name.description: Shown to the clinician when mapping the client for the first time.

client_last_name.title: Client Last Name
client_last_name.description: Shown to the clinician when mapping the client for the first time.

launch_url.title: Launch Url
launch_url.description: Open this URL for the assigned clinician to write the report in Everbility.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Sessions expire 48 hours after creation if not completed.

document_url.title: Document Url
document_url.description: Populated once the session is completed.

content.title: Content
content.description: Rendered report content in the requested format.

bearerAuth.description: Use a Clerk-backed Everbility user or organisation API key directly as the bearer token.

partnerBearer.description: Opaque partner access token (pat_...) issued by POST /v1/partner/oauth/token. Access tokens last 1 hour; refresh with the 90-day refresh token.
